Preserve current child, scalar and resolver and entry and exit pointer identities through presentation and OnAccept. The separate event-byte consumer still needs singleton equality, compatible entry and order and current values; the mode-byte source retains its incoming-key and registry-target gap. The reported host-only deadlock remains unobserved; selected early-return or scalar-mismatch checks are not a diagnosed cause.
falsification: Different initialized slots, receiver loads or tail-call selection falsify these local links. An established child target and preserved host and peer state could identify an authority or lifecycle defect and select a repair.
conclusion: A selected zero-argument root request conditionally constructs a code 17 message with byte+0x34 zero. The selected class's processing method forwards that byte to a concrete root-state consumer. Its accepted zero arm clears bit 0x800 and dispatches the frontend child's resume path; an already-clear bit bypasses those effects. The child publication and final-table path supplies a next callback target. Actual menu input, delivery, factory and processing invocation, current identity, callback effects, host and peer authority and successful resume remain unresolved; no pause fix is selected.
